result.brief: GeoWM 提出几何世界模型，利用几何基础模型将 RGB 帧转为几何历史，并用流匹配 Transformer 直接预测指定未来时刻的场景几何，避免递归 rollout 的误差累积。
result.reason: Geometry world model predicting future scene geometry via flow-matching transformer and geometry foundation model; direct world modeling with non-recursive horizon prediction, relevant to world models and representation.
